description: Report bridge status, siteName, selected page, and editorReady, plus a short theme summary (fonts, default color mode, brand colors). After creating or opening a site, wait until editorReady is true and siteId matches the expected site before editing.

verbose.description: Also return the full site settings object (all theme tokens + custom CSS). Default false — the summary answers 'am I connected and what is open?'.

name: swebsy_status
